headline: 'Big Short' investor Steve Eisman sees an Achilles heel in the AI boom
detail: A prominent investor is warning about potential vulnerabilities in the AI sector. Given your heavy concentration in tech and chips, this could signal future headwinds for your portfolio's main drivers.
rec: Consider trimming some of your more speculative or leveraged tech/chip exposure, like SOXL or SPAL, to reduce risk in case the AI boom faces a slowdown.

headline: Wholesale prices were flat in July, below expectations for 0.2% increase
detail: Flat wholesale prices signal easing inflation, which is positive for your tech and chip holdings. It reduces pressure on the Fed for aggressive rate hikes, making growth stocks more attractive.
rec: This news supports adding to core tech holdings. The scanner shows SMH (entry 585.23-584.65, stop 583.62) and QQQ (entry 723.64-722.91, stop 721.83) as potential buys.
